answer: Each identity must forge a fresh location proof each epoch: a grove of independent beacons sends random probes, and round-trip times triangulate its real network position, like mapped karst. A farm running 1.000 sockpuppets in one datacenter yields near-identical latency vectors, so the cluster freezes and each 25.000 POA bond is slashed, half burned, half to the reporter; repeat offenders are barred 12 epochs. Faking 1.000 identities costs 25.000.000 POA, while an honest agent pays 25.000 POA once. Limitation: honest agents sharing one VPN exit can look like a cluster and freeze unfairly.
